notes.title: Formilion Soundtrack is out now!
notes.notes:
I am pleased to present to you the opportunity to experience the Formilion Soundtrack.
The soundtrack includes 24 tracks. Hope you enjoy it!
[b]Thank you for your attention![/b]

notes.title: Formilion is available now!
notes.notes:
I'm excited to share with you the news that [b]the game is out.[/b] 
I hope it will attract your attention and you will spend your time with pleasure in it. Also the soundtrack will be released soon. 
[b]Thank you for your attention![/b]
